_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
description: Defines the Main Goal Location:
Defeat Sahelanthropus: Complete Mission 31: SAHELANTHROPUS
Defeat [EXTREME] Sahelanthropus: Complete Mission 50: [EXTREME] SAHELANTHROPUS
Complete All Missions: Complete all 51 Missions in the game
Complete All Important Missions: Complete all Missions in the game, exempt of repeated missions with difficulty modifiers
Found The Truth: Complete Mission 46: TRUTH: THE MAN WHO SOLD THE WORLD
Morpho Butterfly: Collect all 10 Memento Photos for Paz, and obtain the Morpho Butterfly Photo

_filler_traps.comment: Changes a % of filler items to 3 traps enabled by other trap options. Those being the Dismiss Buddy, Stink Trap, and Demonism Traps

description: This option removes items relating to unlocking each mission, if set to true, each mission is unlocked by completing the previous one, making you play in a linear mission order
This is the real meat and potatos of this randomizer.
This option adds every 'optional' mission task listed under all 51 Missions in the game
Turning this option off and Development on May or Will result in errors as not all progression items can be placed
This option adds all repeated missions into the multiworld (items and checks)
These Feature [TOTAL STEALTH], [EXTREME], and [SUBSISTENCE] Missions, These make up 12 of 51 Missions in the game.
This option adds all missions after Mission 31
This option adds a check for every entry on the research tree
To Support this, this also adds all relevant Materials and Team Levels required to research each item into the pool.
Adds all research items that require an Internet connection to develop, while also adding the equivalant items to the pool.
This option also adds extra research team levels up to the max amount (162)
This option is not completed (WIP)
Adds all research items that require owning DLC, or a Importing a Ground Zeroes Save File
This option is not completed (WIP)
Adds a Check for Completing each Mission with an S Rank, unless not aplicable
Setting This option on will remove the randomized checks from Mission 0
You will still start with Mission 0, but you can check off the event immediately without having to play the mission
Adds the 20 Important Combat Deployments as checks, these require levels of the Combat Team, and the Battle Gear item for the last 5
Adds all Small Diamonds as checks, including 144 Diamonds on Mother Base, 60 in Afghanistan, and 30 in Africa
Adds all Large Diamonds as checks, including 19 Diamonds in Afghanistan, and 17 in Africa
Adds all Poster Locations as checks, including 2 Posters on Mother Base, 15 in Afghanistan, and 16 in Africa
Adds all Collectable Cassette Locations as checks, including 41 Collectable Music Cassettes, 7 of Which you start with
This also includes 12 Aquired Tapes (to be added later)
Adds all Collectable Blueprint Locations as checks
Adds all Collectable Shipping Labels as checks
This does not currently do anything, but in the future would add checks on every cargo container
Adds extracting all Animals as checks
This Option (when false) will make requirnments so all overworld collectables must be collected inside the 50 missions, so the player will never need to enter free roam for them.
If turned on, may result in a large Sphere 1/2, as all collectables will be up for grabs at the start.
Theoretically this will also remove any check that is not included in any mission area
This option does not apply to collectables on Mother Base, or to Side Ops.
This Option will add a requirnment to complete all Missions available in your seed to your Goal Location.
This Option will not do anything if your goal is All Important Missions. It also will not Apply to Goals for Both SAHELANTHROPUS Missions, or TRUTH
This Option will add a requirnment to complete all Important Missions available in your seed to your Goal Location.
This Option is irrelivent if your Goal is All Missions Cleared. It also will not Apply to Goals for Both SAHELANTHROPUS Missions, or TRUTH
This Option will add a requirnment to complete Mission 31: SAHELANTHROPUS to your Goal Location.
This Option will add a requirnment to complete Mission 50: [EXTREME] SAHELANTHROPUS to your Goal Location.
This Option will add a requirnment to complete Mission 45: TRUTH: THE MAN WHO SOLD THE WORLD to your Goal Location.
This Option will have you search the multiworld for 10 Momento Photos to give to Paz on the Medical Platform.
this will also be an Extra Requirment added to your Goal Location.
Chicken Hat: This Option will make checks require a lot of extra gear before tackling hard missions and tasks
Normal: Standard Difficulty, you should expect a medium/decent amount of gear before harder missions are expected to be completed
EXTREME: This option will assume that you have EXTREME patience and resolve, removing many soft requirnments for harder missions
Decides on how the Progressive Team Levels are givin when Development is turned on.
The Max level of each team is 162, this number is lowered to close to what is needed in the base development tree if you have online development off, but will fill all 162 if on.
This option splits these team levels into groups, being 'Progressive R&D Team Level', '5 Progressive R&D Team Levels', '10 Progressive R&D Team Levels', and so on.
The Base Development Team is Exempt from this option, as only 4 ever fill into the pool at once
Determines how the Development Tree Items are recieved
Progressive: Progressive Items will be recieved, so you will always start with the lowest tier and go up
Split: Items will be recieved in specific tiers, allowing you to get Grade 5 without recieving Grade 2, this excludes unlocks that cannot be equiped at a lower Grade after researching them.
Combined: You will recieve an Item and all its Grades as 1 Item, instead of splitting them
Categories: You Will recieve unlocks as categories, all Handguns and All Uniforms, etc, as one singular item unlock
This Option will enable some checks that have messy requirnments that aren't implemented yet
Adds Trap items that raise the Enemy Preparedness of each category of the games Revenge System
Adds Trap items that have you dismiss the current buddy on receiving them
Adds Trap items that make you very stinky
Adds Trap item that Maxes out your Demon Points
